annotations.title: Markdown & Code Aware Smart RAG Document Chunker API

description: Markdown & Code Aware Smart RAG Document Chunker API: Split Markdown into token-budgeted RAG chunks with heading breadcrumbs and intact code/tables. (Endpoint: POST /v1/rag-chunker)

max_tokens.description: Target maximum token budget per chunk (default: 256).

overlap_tokens.description: Approximate trailing token overlap carried into the next chunk within the same section (default: 24).

prepend_breadcrumbs.description: Prepend the active Markdown heading breadcrumb path (e.g. '[Context: Guide > Auth]') to each chunk's 'text' field for embedding context.

split_on_heading_level.description: Always start a new chunk when encountering a heading at or above this level (1 = H1, 2 = H1/H2).

text.description: Raw Markdown, technical documentation, or prose document to split into semantic RAG chunks.
text.example:
# Edge Gateway Guide

## Authentication
All API calls require a proxy secret header.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.tinplate.dev/v1/json-heal
```

## Rate Limits
| Plan | Quota |
| --- | --- |
| Basic | 100 |
| Pro | 10000 |
